content: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Otterly.ai: Senior Business Development Representative Anywhere in the World Niederösterreich Digital Marketing, HubSpot, Outreach, Sales Management, Sales, and LinkedIn Outreach Sales and Marketing Contract <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/5986/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Austria, Linz <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://otterly.ai/">https://otterly.ai/</a> </p> <h3>Role Overview:</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced<strong> New Business Development Representative</strong> who knows how to create opportunities, not just wait for them.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a senior outbound role focused on building high-quality pipelines for our Account Executive team, whom you will work with closely on a daily basis.. You'll identify target accounts, engage decision-makers through multi-channel outreach, qualify opportunities, and book meetings with companies that have meaningful revenue potential.</p> <p>You'll have the autonomy and freedom to test messaging, refine outbound strategies, and help shape how OtterlyAI goes to market. We care about quality over quantity—you'll focus on opening doors where OtterlyAI can create meaningful business impact, not simply hitting activity metrics.</p> <h3>Main Responsibilities:</h3> <p><br><strong>1. Outbound Pipeline Generation</strong>: Build and manage outbound campaigns targeting marketing leaders, SEO teams, digital agencies, and enterprise organizations using LinkedIn, email, phone, and other creative outreach channels.<br><strong>2. Account-Based Prospecting:</strong> Research and prioritize high-value accounts, identify key stakeholders, and develop personalized outreach that cuts through the noise.<br><strong>3. Multi-Channel Outreach:</strong> Execute thoughtful cold and warm outreach across LinkedIn,<br>email, calling, and other channels to consistently generate qualified meetings.<br><strong>4. Opportunity Qualification</strong>: Understand prospect pain points, qualify opportunities, and ensure every meeting handed to an Account Executive has a strong likelihood of progressing.<br><strong>5. Pipeline Development: </strong>Own your pipeline targets by generating qualified opportunities that contribute directly to company growth and revenue.<br><strong>6. Market Intelligence:</strong> Continuously gather insights from prospects, competitors, and the AI search landscape to improve messaging and identify new opportunities.<br><strong>7. Process Improvement: </strong>Help optimize outbound playbooks, messaging, sequencing, and targeting as we continue to scale our sales motion.<br><br></p> <h3>Main Requirements:</h3> <p><strong>Must Have:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>4+ years of outbound BDR/SDR experience in B2B SaaS ( MarTech, SEO, AI or Digital Marketing Solutions)</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record of consistently exceeding outbound meeting or pipeline targets</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience prospecting into mid-market and enterprise organizations</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong LinkedIn, email, and cold-calling skills</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience using tools: HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Clay, or similar outbound tools</p> </li> <li> <p>Fluent English (C1+)</p> </li> <li> <p>Self-starter who enjoys ownership in a fast-growing remote scale-up</p> </li> <li> <p>Available to collaborate across EU and US time zones.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Familiarity with Account-Based Sales (ABS) or Account-Based Marketing (ABM)</p> </li> <li> <p>Additional European languages</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience building outbound campaigns from scratch.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br>What OtterlyAI Offers:</h3> <ul> <li> <p>€4,000/month base (B2B contractor arrangement)</p> </li> <li> <p>Uncapped commission based on qualified pipeline and closed business</p> </li> <li> <p>Remote-first - work from anywhere in Europe</p> </li> <li> <p>Flexible schedule with overlap across Europe and US timezones</p> </li> <li> <p>Direct collaboration with founders and sales leadership</p> </li> <li> <p>Opportunity to help define and scale OtterlyAI's outbound motion</p> </li> </ul> <h3><br>Recruitment Process:</h3> <ol> <li> <p>CV and brief selection: <br>When submitting your CV, please also include a short note of 3 - 4 paragraphs covering:</p> </li> </ol> <ul> <li> <p>Your most successful outbound campaign</p> </li> <li> <p>The most creative way you've booked a difficult prospect</p> </li> <li> <p>One insight about the future of AI search or SEO</p> </li> </ul> <ol> <li> <p>Video Call: If your CV and brief note aligns with our requirements, HR invites you for an initial video call.</p> </li> <li> <p>Interview with the CRO: A deeper discussion about your experience, sales methodology, and previous achievements.</p> </li> <li> <p>Challenge: Create an outreach strategy to high-tier leads for OtterlyAI prospects.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Final Interview: Meet the founders and discuss how you would help OtterlyAI scale.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Offer: If all goes well, we'll share an offer, and you can start your journey with <a href="http://otterly.ai/">Otterly.ai</a></p> </li> </ol> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/otterly-ai-senior-business-development-representative-1">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/otterly-ai-senior-business-development-representative-1</a></p> Mon, 27 Jul 2026 15:14:53 +0000 Wed, 26 Aug 2026 15:14:53 +0000 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/otterly-ai-senior-business-development-representative-1 https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/otterly-ai-senior-business-development-representative-1 OnTheGoSystems: AI-Native Software Developer Anywhere in the World Nevada Ruby on Rails, Testing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Full-Stack Programming Full-Time <img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/2344/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" /> <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> Remote <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://onthegosystems.com">http://onthegosystems.com</a> </p> <h4>About OTGS</h4> <p>At OnTheGoSystems, we build products used by hundreds of thousands of websites worldwide.
